([[Woodstock, Virginia]]) | college = [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State]] (2020–2022) | draft_year = 2022 | career_start = 2022 | years1 = {{nbay|2022|start}}–{{nbay|2023|end}} | team1 = [[New Orleans Pelicans]] | years2 = [[2022–23 NBA G League season|2022]]–[[2023–24 NBA G League season|2024]] | team2 = →[[Birmingham Squadron]] | years3 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024]] | team3 = [[Motor City Cruise]] | years4 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024]] | team4 = [[Salt Lake City Stars]] | years5 = [[2024–25 NBA G League season|2024]] | team5 = Motor City Cruise | years6 = 2025–2026 | team6 = [[Beijing Royal Fighters]] | years7 = [[2025–26 NBA G League season|2026]] | team7 = Salt Lake City Stars | years8 = [[2026–27 NBA G League season|2026]]–present | team8 = [[Greensboro Swarm]] | highlights = * Second-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] (2022) * [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] Most Improved Player (2022) }} '''Dereon Seabron''' ({{IPAc-en|'|d|ɛr|i|.|ɒ|n}} {{respell|DERR|ee|on}};{{cite press release|title=2023-24 start of season NBA pronunciation guide|url=https://www.nba.com/news/2023-24-start-of-season-nba-pronunciation-guide|website=NBA.com|date=October 24, 2023|access-date=May 18, 2024}} born May 26, 2000) is an American professional [[basketball]] for the [[Greensboro Swarm]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State Wolfpack]]. ==High school career== Seabron played basketball for [[Lake Taylor High School]] in [[Norfolk, Virginia]]. As a sophomore, he helped his team reach the 4A state title game.{{cite web|first=Larry|last=Rubama|title=Lake Taylor's Seabron named 2018 All-Tidewater Boys Basketball Player of the Year|url=https://www.pilotonline.com/757teamz/basketball/article_36c7eb46-2c4b-11e8-ad86-7bbb9f135161.html|work=[[The Virginian-Pilot]]|date=May 26, 2018|access-date=December 3, 2021}} In his junior season, Seabron averaged 17.2 points and seven rebounds per game.{{cite web|first=Matthew|last=Hatfield|title=VaPreps 4A All-State Hoops Teams for 2016-17|url=https://virginiapreps.rivals.com/news/vapreps-4a-all-state-hoops-teams-for-2016-17|website=Rivals.com|date=May 29, 2017|access-date=December 3, 2021}} As a senior, he averaged 22.5 points and 11 rebounds per game, leading Lake Taylor to its first state championship. Seabron was named 4A Player of the Year and All-Tidewater Player of the Year.{{cite web|first=Larry|last=Rubama|title=Lake Taylor's Dereon Seabron makes his choice: College can wait a year|url=https://www.pilotonline.com/757teamz/basketball/article_044906a8-6136-11e8-b84e-a748a9553134.html|work=[[The Virginian-Pilot]]|date=May 26, 2018|access-date=December 3, 2021}} He opted to play a [[postgraduate season]] at [[Massanutten Military Academy]] in [[Woodstock, Virginia]] to gain more attention from college programs.{{cite web|first=Brad|last=Fauber|title=Seabron growing on and off the basketball court at MMA|url=https://www.nvdaily.com/nvdaily/seabron-growing-on-and-off-the-basketball-court-at-mma/article_17578971-29c4-5e90-b3a0-a2398517811b.html|work=[[The Northern Virginia Daily]]|date=January 5, 2019|access-date=December 3, 2021}} A four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]], he committed to playing college basketball for [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State]] in April 2019 over offers from [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]], [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]], [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence]] and [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU]].{{cite web|first=Matt|last=Carter|title=NC State announces the signing of guard Dereon Seabron|url=https://ncstate.rivals.com/news/nc-state-wolfpack-basketball-announces-signing-of-dereon-seabron|website=Rivals.com|date=April 18, 2019|access-date=December 3, 2021}} ==College career== Seabron [[redshirt (college sports)|redshirted]] his first season at NC State after being ruled academically ineligible by the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] and losing the appeal.{{cite web|first=Matthew|last=Bradham|title=NC State's Dereon Seabron to Academically Redshirt 2019-20 Season|url=https://packinsider.com/2019/11/06/31703/|work=Pack Insider|date=November 6, 2019|access-date=December 3, 2021}} In the regular season finale against [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame]], Seabron had his first double-double with 17 points and 13 rebounds, and he earned [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] Freshman of the Week honors. As a freshman, he averaged 5.2 points and 3.5 rebounds per game.{{cite web|first=Justin H.|last=Williams|title=A look ahead at NC State basketball's 2021-22 roster|url=https://ncstate.rivals.com/news/a-look-ahead-at-nc-state-basketball-s-2021-22-roster-2|website=Rivals.com|date=May 2, 2021|access-date=December 3, 2021}} On December 1, 2021, Seabron posted a career-high 39 points and 18 rebounds in a 104–100 win against [[Nebraska Cornhuskers men's basketball|Nebraska]] in quadruple overtime, breaking the [[ACC–Big Ten Challenge]] single-game scoring record.{{cite web|title=Seabron scores 39, N.C. State tops Nebraska in 4 OT|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401370097|work=[[ESPN]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=December 1, 2021|access-date=December 3, 2021}} He scored the most points in a game by an NC State player since [[T. J. Warren]] scored 42 points against [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College]] on March 29, 2014.{{cite web|title=Pack Wins Four Overtime Thriller|url=https://gopack.com/news/2021/12/1/mens-basketball-pack-wins-4ot-thriller.aspx|work=NC State University Athletics|date=December 1, 2021|access-date=December 3, 2021}} As a sophomore, Seabron was named [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] Most Improved Player as well as Second Team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]].{{cite press release|title=ACC Unveils 2021-22 Men's Basketball Awards|url=https://theacc.com/news/2022/3/6/athlete-awards-acc-unveils-2021-22-mens-basketball-awards.aspx|website=TheACC.com|publisher=[[Atlantic Coast Conference]]|date=March 7, 2022|access-date=March 7, 2022}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2022 NBA draft]], Seabron signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] on September 9, 2022.{{cite web|title=Pelicans sign Seabron, Petty Jr., and Plowden|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-roster-dereon-seabron-john-petty-jr-daeqwon-plowden-signed|website=NBA.com|date=September 9, 2022|access-date=March 17, 2023}} On April 6, 2023, the Pelicans waived Seabron,{{cite web|title=Pelicans waive Dereon Seabron|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-roster-dereon-seabron-waived-040623|website=NBA.com|date=April 6, 2023|access-date=April 6, 2023}} but re-signed him to another two-way contract on April 9.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Pelicans Re-Sign Dereon Seabron To Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/04/pelicans-re-sign-dereon-seabron-to-two-way-contract.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=April 9, 2023|access-date=April 16, 2023}} On September 17, 2024, Seabron signed with the [[Detroit Pistons]],{{cite web|first=Dana|last=Gauruder|title=Pistons To Sign Dereon Seabron To Exhibit 10 Contract|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/09/pistons-to-sign-dereon-seabron-to-exhibit-10-contract.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 17, 2024|access-date=September 18, 2024}} but was waived on October 17.{{cite tweet|author=Pistons PR|title=The Detroit Pistons announced today that the team has waived Aaron Estrada, Javante McCoy, Dereon Seabron, Tolu Smith, and Lamar Stevens. Detroit’s roster now stands at 15, including one two-way contract.|number=1847054117455442163|user=Pistons_PR|date=October 17, 2024|access-date=October 17, 2024}} On October 29, he joined the [[Motor City Cruise]].{{cite tweet|author=Motor City Cruise|title=Training camp roster ready to get to it 👏 #MotorCityBasketball|number=1851401150169223597|user=MotorCityCruise|date=October 29, 2024|access-date=November 4, 2024}} On December 27, 2024, Seabron was traded to the [[Salt Lake City Stars]].{{cite web|title=Stars Acquire Dereon Seabron|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/stars-acquire-dereon-seabron/n-6176120|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=December 27, 2024|access-date=December 27, 2024}} ==Career
